estimates.assumptions: 450g boneless skinless chicken thighs (standard for karaage; ~160 kcal, 24.5g protein, 6g fat per 100g)
1 tbsp grated ginger (~15g; standard nutritional values for fresh grated ginger)
2 tbsp soy sauce (~30g; typical values for regular soy sauce)
1/3 cup potato starch (~45g; ~310 kcal per 100g, all carbohydrate)

1/3 cup vegetable oil for deep frying; assumes ~120ml total with ~80-90% absorbed by the 450g chicken during frying (standard estimate for karaage oil uptake), ~530 kcal and 60g fat actually contributed to the finished dish
1/3 cup lemon (interpreted as wedges/slices from ~1/2 small lemon for serving; ~20g edible portion)
